scope: Read-only packaging/script review; no rerun or full188 scientific reassessment; no frozenA or B review bytes changed

findings.finding: Passed status, exit_code0, full/completed coverage and counts are asserted in generated prose without reading/asserting the final execution results or final payload/review bindings. Merely hashing a report proves its bytes, not that its checks passed or match the final proposals.
findings.recommendation: Before emitting completed synthesis, require188 exact cases, unique final proposal paths, final structural audit success, actual strict-validator exit and zeroerrors for the exact final payload manifest, invariants success, and complete scientific-review bindings for every final payload. Preserve actual command/exit receipts; add their files and agent-scopes/review captures to inspect inputs. Failure or an unavailable required check must stop generation or produce a partial/blocked review.
findings.observed_state: At inspection the final structural-audit, invariants and integration-review files were absent, as expected while the lastC pair was pending. Existing schemaTSV contained only its header. Current assembled fragments had188 cases and98 proposals; these are a prefinal observation, not a final acceptance.

findings.finding: Proposal assessments cite their author evidence plus schema and integration review but omit associated cases independent scientific-review evidence. All98 currently assembled proposal evidence lists lack IR-* entries. N-INTEGRATION expressly does not replace A review of B-authored science.
findings.recommendation: Union independent_review.evidence_ids from every associated case into each proposal assessment, and verify the referenced scientific review actually binds that proposal final afterhash. Keep cross-case applicability review separate from exactpayload author-review independence. The team-level self_review declaration should remain.

findings.finding: Every case has a primary-evidence assessment can be read as claiming successful direct primary coverage for every occurrence, including documented provider failures or metadata-only recipes.
findings.recommendation: Use every frozen case has a source-bound assessment and separate skeptical review, including explicit primary-access and source-version gaps. Completed assessment concerns the bounded review work, not primary retrieval success, resolved identity, or release approval.

findings.finding: Every unresolved/malformed case becomes a confirmed major identity finding by template. A documented access or specification gap is confirmed as a limitation, but it does not confirm that the ingredient identity itself is erroneous.
findings.recommendation: Make the certainty subject explicit as the observed source-evidence gap, or use provisional where the scientific defect remains unproven. Reserve confirmed identity-error wording for demonstrated contradictions. Do not erase the authored case-specific limitation with generic severity/certainty prose.

positive_assessments: Team-authored synthesis correctly declares independence=self_review and names the distinct author/reviewer chain.
needs_curation, explicit inherited-owner exclusions and no-release limitations are appropriate; completed assessment need not mean every identity resolved.
Original external access timestamps are retained; missing timestamps are explicitly labeled local inspection rather than fabricated retrieval.
Failed/negative searches are context_only with bounded search_scope and no global-absence claim.

Current evidence/proposal tokens, kind mappings, issue-string shape, target/assessment fields and enum values are compatible with the native schema on read-only inspection. Full native validation remains required after final generation.
